cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hide Inside the Callback
cards.instruction: Use an early harmless detail as the explanation for each new consequence, keeping your own role outside the pattern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll dry your letter. That cup was much too close to it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was in your hand when you tipped it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it across the room. Pass me a towel before the ink runs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Don't rub it. That's how you ruined the envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You blot the letter; I'll hold the towel underneath. We're not losing that to the cup as well.

reason: Replace the unlocated address with the already established letter, preserving the envelope-to-letter consequence and B prompted method change.
